gitignoreSecretBoundary.reason: Fingerprints the exact root .gitignore lines that keep the untracked .env (holding JWT_SECRET and DB_PASSWORD) out of the repository, per CLAUDE.md's Auth boundary. This is the ONLY thing this file records — a secret itself is never baselined. Relaxing or removing one of these lines is now a visible diff here, reviewed like any other change, instead of a silent widening of what git will track.

confirmedFakeValues.reason: Regression guard for a real security fix proving the raw bearer token never lands in the persisted cache key; the JWT shape is load-bearing for that assertion to mean anything to a reader. This entry becomes unnecessary the moment frontend/src may be edited and the fixture is reshaped to a value this check's heuristics do not flag.
